items.item_text: Successful completion of Certified Nursing Assistant program.
High School GED or High School Graduate
Six (6) months recent long term care facility experience as an Restorative Nurse Assistant - RNA

Performs and educates family members, as indicated, the restorative care functions that may include, but are not necessarily be limited to: 1) ROM (AROM & PROM) 2) Ambulation assistance 3) Eating assistance 4) ADL assistance 5) Bowel & Bladder Training 6) Splint / Brace / Prosthesis placement / care. Performs the above duties as well as lifting, moving, positioning and transporting of patients while using proper techniques and/or equipment. Measurements: Observation, Feedback, Equipment condition, Variance reports.
In addition to those listed in 1.1 above, demonstrates basic skills including, but not necessarily limited to: Patient hygiene

(bathing, grooming, oral and care, back rubs); Documentation of baseline data (vital signs, intake and output), Knowledge of mobility and precautions for orthopedic patients; Skin care for immobilized patients; Infection control & prevention. Measurements: Observation, Feedback, Chart documentation.

Documents restorative functions performed as well as resident and/or family response to same. Additionally, records other pertinent information clearly, accurately, and timely. Measurements: Documentation, Feedback.
Reports pertinent information to appropriate person(s) / positions, including information needed for IDT / Care Planning conferences. Measurements: Documentation, Feedback.
Participates in continuing education in areas applicable to position and the patient population. Measurements: Education records.
